lesson.title: Reach the Drop
lesson.hook: Two connected choices. Watch what your first shot creates.
lesson.liveIntro: You read the drop late from behind the baseline. You reach it low, still moving forward.

td1A.name: You reached it. What does this next contact need?
td1A.sit: They reply to your backhand as you regain a balanced net position.
td1A.q: You reached it. What does this next contact need?

lines.A: You regain control with a compact volley and a generous target.
lines.B: The small angle lands, but adds difficulty while you are finding balance.

td1A.take: Reaching a drop shot is only the first job. Your balance shapes the reply.
td1A.payoff: Reaching a drop shot is only the first job. Your balance shapes the reply.
td1A.principle: Reach the ball, then find balance. Keep the next shot playable.
td1A.why: A late pickup below the net needs clearance and a manageable target. The illustration shows a playable recovery, not a miracle winner. After the pickup, organise your feet and racket for the actual passing shot.

td1B.name: You reached it. What does this next contact need?

td1B.q: You reached it. What does this next contact need?

lines.A: You adjust to the wider pass and keep the next ball playable.
lines.B: The wider contact makes that short target even more demanding.

pro.label: Paul · Reaching it kept the story alive
pro.moment: On the last point of his 2025 US Open match against Borges, Tommy Paul chased a volley that had dribbled over the net cord. Then he had to retreat before hitting the forehand that wrong-footed Borges. The desperate first retrieval kept the chance to play that next shot alive.
pro.read: Your next point: you arrive low and late. Make a manageable reply, then recover for the next ball instead of treating the retrieval as the finish.
pro.src: US Open match report · Paul v Borges · 29 August 2025

drill.name: Two-ball read
drill.how: Begin deep. Have a partner disguise an occasional drop shot, then play a pass after your pickup. Judge the pickup height and how quickly you regain balance.
